title: Sunset Humanity
description:
Take on the role of Pierre, a work-from-home employee for the mysterious ¾ Infinity Corp. Your job is to run and monitor a prototype A.I code-named “Laplace”. Follow the corporation's email instructions, and be sure to keep an eye out for any anomalies that may appear around your living quarters.

Features• Fully functioning in-game computer, complete with an internet browser, minigames, and a file system.

• No blood or gore. The environments will serve to unnerve you rather than graphic content.

• A short but jam-packed experience intended to be finished in under 30 minutes. 

• An included guide for those just wanting to experience the story.

Bonus ContentExplore brand new areas, browse the internet, and learn more about the secrets of this alternative reality in the Steam release! Now with double the content of the original release.
description_short: Help a rogue A.I bring about the end of humanity in this short psychological horror game.
